lines.text: Two hundred steps to the top. I wasn't going to *make* it.
lines.style: First-person survivor, feverish, gasping while climbing, hoarse and fading, calm acceptance on the last words.
Narrating, breathless, sudden dread, the last word sharp.

lines.text: The generator was dead. So I *woke* it.
lines.style: Narrating, exhausted but stubborn, a grim spark of determination on the last words.
Teenage girl, horrified whisper, voice breaking, a long pause after the name.
A dying young man, very soft and gentle, sad and calm, almost a whisper.

lines.text: Read it when I'm gone. Now lock the *hatch.*
lines.style: A dying young man handing over a letter, gentle and tender on the first sentence, then firm and urgent.
Teenage girl begging, crying, voice cracking, desperate and heartbroken, getting louder.
A young man calling up from below, quiet and loving but final, holding back tears.

lines.text: If you're reading this, I didn't make it. Keep the light on. Someone will *see* it.
lines.style: Teenage girl reading a farewell letter aloud through tears, broken voice, trembling, slow, gathering strength on the last sentence.

lines.text: I watched the coast all night, waiting for a light to answer.
lines.style: Teenage girl narrating quietly, hollow and still, hope slowly draining away.

lines.text: I kept the light on. Every night.
lines.style: Teenage girl narrating, soft and steady, lonely, older than her years.
Teenage girl, a final quiet whisper, utterly alone, a long breath before the last word.

music.title: Last Light - Last Light
music.style: Sad, sparse cinematic finale. Solo piano and slow strings. Opens tense with a low pulse and breathing strings during a desperate climb, then falls into a fragile, aching piano theme. A tender, heartbreaking string swell as a great light comes on, then long, lonely, quiet piano notes with lots of space and silence, fading to nothing. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under dialogue.
